title: Finite Time Type I Singularities of the Kähler Ricci Flow
summary: We prove the Feldman--Ilmanen--Knopf conjecture for finite time Type I singularities of the Kähler--Ricci flow. More precisely, for any compact Kähler manifold $Y$ and its blow-up $π:\operatorname{Bl}_pY\longrightarrow Y$, if $[ω_0]-Tc_1(M)=π^*[ω_Y]$, then any Type I parabolic blow-up limit of the Kähler Ricci flow along the exceptional divisor is the FIK shrinker $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^{n-1}}(-1))$.
